title: Administrative deployment descriptor for AVALANCHE_IMPLEMENTATION_001
description: The exact administrative input consumed by `presence-avalanche-vm --materialize-genesis TEMPLATE DESCRIPTOR PUBLIC_AUTHORITY OUTPUT`. Supplying this input is an administrative act; it is not release qualification, deployment, formation, succession, Authority or Presence. Validation authority remains the VM's own DeploymentDescriptor.Validate (genesis.go); this schema mirrors it for administrators.

genesis_id.description: Safe identifier for the materialized genesis. Must be distinct from the formation-ancestor genesis identity.

locality_id.description: Safe identifier of the locality body. Must not be the historical formation ancestor KENTRA.

purpose.description: Bounded human-readable purpose of this genesis.

source_reference.description: Safe identifier naming the administrative source mandate for this deployment.

source_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 commitment to the administrative source mandate.

companion_inputs.public_authority: locality-authority.public.json produced by `--generate-authority DIRECTORY`; the private counterpart must never be committed or persisted beyond its administrative purpose
companion_inputs.output_check: verify the produced genesis with `--check-genesis OUTPUT` before any use
